Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted an incorrect SERP snippet claiming Dani Kouyaté was born in 1936 (likely conflating with Sotigui Kouyaté) without verifying via the actual source page; credible sources list Dani Kouyaté’s birth year as 1961. This led to concluding Keïta! L'Héritage Du Griot instead of the correct The Raven's Dance.
